parameters.query: SELECT c.id, c.source, c.company, c.job_title, c.lead_score, c.lead_status, c.custom_fields, c.created_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id) as total_activities, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.activity_type = 'email_opened') as emails_opened, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.activity_type = 'email_clicked') as emails_clicked, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.activity_type = 'page_view') as page_views, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.activity_type = 'meeting_scheduled') as meetings, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM lead_activities la WHERE la.contact_id = c.id AND la.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days') as activities_7d, CASE WHEN c.lead_status = 'customer' THEN true ELSE false END as converted FROM contacts c WHERE c.lead_status NOT IN ('lost') AND c.created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '180 days'

{{ $json.score_updates.slice(0, 30).map(p => `UPDATE contacts SET lead_score = ${p.predicted_score} WHERE id = ${p.contact_id} AND ABS(lead_score - ${p.predicted_score}) >= 10`).join('; ') || 'SELECT 1' }}
